description: This PHP class 'ProjectActivityDetailedReportData' within the 'OrangeHRM\Time\Report' namespace implements report data processing for detailed project activity reports. It fetches and formats report data, including employee activity details and total durations, and provides report metadata.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for fetching, processing, and normalizing detailed project activity report data, including employee time entries and report metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the report data object with filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Retrieves and formats detailed report data for each project employee based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Generates and returns metadata for the report, including total hours, detailed activity info, and total count.
